solid.title: SOLID Principles
content: SOLID is a set of design principles that help developers write maintainable and scalable code.
Each principle helps you build better software.

triple.title: Triple Constraint
content: The Triple Constraint is a project management concept: Scope, Time, Cost.
Balancing these three factors is key to successful project delivery.

bigo.title: Big O
content: Big O notation describes the performance of algorithms.
It helps you analyze time and space complexity.
Understanding Big O is essential for writing efficient code.

learning.title: Brews: What is a Brew?
learning.subTitle: A Brew is a compact learning experience designed to grow your skills, refresh your knowledge, and spark exploration of deeper concepts you can use every day.
learning.explanation: We don’t all have time for lengthy courses, so our Brews are crafted to spark your curiosity — covering the topics that matter most, from development and data science to business and project management.
